display.purpose: Section titles, Archivo 900 at width 125, caps.

title.purpose: Project index names, Archivo 900 at width 112.

label.purpose: Condensed caps (width 72) for dates, kinds, counts and the Sample data tag.

script.purpose: Mr Dafoe, one use: the hero 'Gaming & Game Dev' line in signal red.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Surfaces are flat; no hard offset shadows.

shadows.name: contact-pad
shadows.purpose: Soft contact shadow under the 3D controller pad only.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for every state change; the snap.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Press feedback on buttons, rows and links; hover lift is 2px over 200ms.

motion.name: lenis
motion.purpose: Smooth scroll; absent under reduced motion.

motion.name: dot-spring
motion.purpose: Dot logo physics: slight overshoot, then settle.

motion.name: dot-pointer
motion.value: lerp 0.35, radius 62 + min(speed*5,120)px, heat min(1,speed*0.05), press burst 170px
motion.purpose: Pointer scatter and heat on the dot logo.

motion.name: cursor-reticle
motion.value: 28px ring, 4 ticks, max 360px; hero only, fine pointer, motion allowed
motion.purpose: Thermal reticle cursor states: idle, open over logo, pulse on press.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Cream fill, ink text; lifts 2px on hover, scales 0.97 on press.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:3rem; padding:0 1.35rem; background:#f2eadb; color:#1e181e; border:0; border-radius:0; font-weight:800; font-variation-settings:'wdth' 110; font-size:0.95rem; letter-spacing:0.02em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition: translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), scale 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn:hover { translate: 0 -2px; } .ds-btn:active { scale:0.97; translate:0 0; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f2eadb; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Red Button
components.description: Brand red primary action (Pick your spawn point).
components.css: .ds-btn-red { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:3rem; padding:0 1.35rem; background:#ad0013; color:#f2eadb; border:0; border-radius:0; font-weight:800; font-variation-settings:'wdth' 110; font-size:0.95rem; letter-spacing:0.02em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition: translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), scale 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-red:hover { translate:0 -2px; } .ds-btn-red:active { scale:0.97; translate:0 0; } .ds-btn-red:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f2eadb; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent with a 1.5px inset outline in the current colour.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:3rem; padding:0 1.35rem; background:transparent; color:#f2eadb; border:0; border-radius:0; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px currentColor; font-weight:800; font-variation-settings:'wdth' 110; font-size:0.95rem; letter-spacing:0.02em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition: translate 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), scale 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { translate:0 -2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { scale:0.97; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f2eadb; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Label and Sample Tag
components.description: Condensed caps label; also the required 'Sample data' tag for mock content.
components.css: .ds-label { font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:700; font-variation-settings:'wdth' 72; letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:#e3d6c3; } .ds-chip { display:inline-block; padding:0.35rem 0.65rem; background:#1e181e; color:#f2eadb; font-weight:700; border-radius:0; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Underline draws from the left in 250ms and retracts in 180ms.
components.css: .ds-link { font-weight:500; font-size:0.95rem; color:#f2eadb; text-decoration:none; padding-bottom:0.12em; background: linear-gradient(currentColor,currentColor) left bottom / 0% 1.5px no-repeat; transition: background-size 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-link:hover, .ds-link:focus-visible { background-size:100% 1.5px; transition-duration:250ms; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f2eadb; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Domain Spawn Row
components.description: A huge expanded-caps domain name on the red band; selection slides the name, draws an ink underline and reveals a chevron.
components.css: .ds-domain { position:relative; display:block; width:100%; padding:0.35em 0; border:0; border-bottom:2px solid #1e181e; border-radius:0; background:none; text-align:left; font-family:inherit; font-weight:900; font-variation-settings:'wdth' 125; font-size:2.4rem; line-height:1; letter-spacing:-0.03em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#f2eadb; cursor:pointer; } .ds-text { position:relative; display:inline-block; translate:0 0; transition:translate 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-text::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:-0.1em; height:2px; background:#1e181e; scale:0 1; transform-origin:left center; transition:scale 240ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-chev { position:absolute; left:-0.15em; top:50%; width:0.4em; height:0.64em; margin-top:-0.32em; color:#f2eadb; opacity:0; translate:-0.5em 0; transition:translate 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), opacity 200ms; } .ds-on .ds-text { translate:0.3em 0; } .ds-on .ds-text::after { scale:1 1; } .ds-on .ds-chev { opacity:1; translate:0 0; } .ds-domain:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f2eadb; outline-offset:-3px; }

components.name: Project Index Row
components.description: Cartridge row on the red band: name, meta, year, with an ink bar that fills under it on focus or expansion.
components.css: .ds-row { position:relative; display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto; grid-template-areas:'name year' 'meta meta'; align-items:center; column-gap:1rem; row-gap:0.3rem; width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:1.1rem 0; border:0; border-bottom:2px solid #1e181e; background:none; text-align:left; color:#f2eadb; cursor:pointer; } .ds-row::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; height:4px; background:#1e181e; transform-origin:left center; scale:0 1; transition:scale 300ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-row:hover::after, .ds-row:focus-visible::after { scale:1 1; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f2eadb; outline-offset:-3px; } .ds-name { grid-area:name; font-weight:900; font-variation-settings:'wdth' 112; font-size:1.8rem; line-height:1.02; letter-spacing:-0.03em; } .ds-meta { grid-area:meta; font-weight:700; font-size:0.8rem; font-variation-settings:'wdth' 72; letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-year { grid-area:year; font-weight:700; text-align:right; }

components.name: Raised Card
components.description: Ink 2 square card on the ink band; border turns signal on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { display:grid; gap:0.75rem; padding:1.6rem; background:#2a222a; color:#f2eadb; border:1px solid rgba(242,234,219,0.16); border-radius:0; transition:border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color:#e5323a; } .ds-tag { justify-self:start; padding:0.2rem 0.6rem; background:#ad0013; color:#f2eadb; font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:700; font-variation-settings:'wdth' 72; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.06em; } .ds-card-t { margin:0; font-weight:900; font-variation-settings:'wdth' 112; font-size:1.6rem; line-height:1.1; }

narrative.overview:
OASIS is the club's own recruitment poster turned into a page, then made playable. The surface is warm black ink and a brand red band, split by thin rules, with cream type and a film of grain over everything. Halftone dots sit on the red fields and as a faint screen on the hero. The page is played, not browsed: the first screen is the wordmark itself, built from halftone dots that heat, scatter and settle under the hand.

The system is flat, square and printed. There are no soft cards, no rounded corners, no glow. Depth comes from alternating ink and red bands, 2px rules, and grain. Colour is rationed: cream carries text, signal red carries heat and large display type, gold appears only where something has been earned.
keyCharacteristics: Ink and brand-red bands alternate below a flat near-black hero; cream type throughout.
Archivo on its width axis (expanded for display, condensed for labels) plus one retro script (Mr Dafoe), used once per surface.
Grain over the whole page (7% opacity), halftone on red and signal fields.
Square corners everywhere; round shapes are drawn only as true circles.
Motion verb is "heat and settle": springs for what the hand touches, strong ease-out for everything else.
Mock content is always tagged "Sample data".

rules.name: The Earned Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold marks something achieved or kept: a milestone on the timeline, a framed member. It never decorates, never fills a button, never colours a heading.

rules.name: The Heat Rule
rules.body: Signal red means heat or attention (motion speed, hover, selection, the hero script). It is not a second brand fill; bands use Brand Red.

rules.name: The Cream Text Rule
rules.body: Text is cream or cream 2 on every field. No grey text, no opacity-faded copy on red; the contrast pairs above are the floor.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is made with Archivo's width, not new families: 125 expanded for titles, 72 condensed for labels, 100 for reading.

rules.name: The One Script Rule
rules.body: Mr Dafoe appears once, in the hero, in signal red. It is a signature, not a texture.

rules.name: The Flat Print Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift with shadow. Hover moves the element (2px up), never adds depth.

rules.name: The Grain Rule
rules.body: One grain layer over the whole page, normal blend, never per component.

rules.name: The Hero-Only Cursor Rule
rules.body: The custom cursor lives in the hero and nowhere else. Every other surface keeps the native cursor.

rules.name: The Settle Rule
rules.body: Anything that heats up must cool and return home. No effect is left running or stuck in a hot state.

dos: Do alternate ink (#1e181e) and brand red (#ad0013) bands with 2px rules and keep type cream.
Do keep every corner square (0px); draw circles only where the shape is a circle.
Do put hierarchy in Archivo's width axis (125 titles, 112 names, 100 body, 72 labels).
Do use cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) for state changes and 0.97 press scale at 140ms.
Do tag every mock-data surface with a "Sample data" label.
Do hide the nav wordmark while the hero logo is on screen.
Do give every motion a reduced-motion equivalent that shows the final state.
donts: Don't use gold for decoration, buttons or headings; it marks earned moments.
Don't add offset shadows, glows or rounded corners.
Don't extend the custom cursor beyond the hero.
Don't put the hero logo and nav wordmark on screen together.
Don't put a gradient in the hero ground; it is flat near-black.
Don't use signal red for body text on ink; it clears contrast only at large size.
